summary: Changes safeGit to return a GitResult object with code, stdout and stderr instead of throwing on failure. Also exports the GitResult type from the core package.

findings.title: Return type change breaks both CLI callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object instead of a stdout string and no longer throws. The callers in packages/cli/src/branch.ts:7 and packages/cli/src/status.ts:6 still call trim() and split() on the result.
findings.consequence: changedFiles throws a TypeError on every call, so the status command breaks. currentBranch catches its own TypeError and always returns null, even inside a repository.
findings.fix: Update both callers in this change to check result.code and read result.stdout. currentBranch should return null when code is not zero.

findings.title: Changed error behaviour has no covering test
findings.problem: safeGit now catches failures and returns an exit code instead of throwing. No test in the repository covers either path.
findings.consequence: Nothing would have caught the broken callers. Nothing will catch a later regression in the code mapping either.
findings.fix: Add tests for safeGit success and failure results. Add tests for currentBranch and changedFiles against the new shape.
